title: Charleston Sailing School & Yacht Charters

services.name: Courses Offered
services.desc: Have you ever dreamed of living aboard or bareboat chartering a yacht? Immerse yourself in the sailing lifestyle. Our Liveaboard Programs provide students with the ability to accomplish multiple certifications while experiencing life aboard a modern cruising yacht. With our Liveaboard programs, we include all certifications, operating expenses, and accommodations during your stay. Charleston provides the ideal setting for our student to relax, learn, and enjoy the sport of sailing. We design our Liveaboard courses to provide a unique and memorable training experience for each student. services.name: Yacht Charters
services.desc: Explore Charleston By Water! Private Yacht Charters are available for hourly, daily, and weekly excursions. One of our qualified captains will safely escort you through your voyage, and up to 6 passengers may ride along during the voyage. Guests are encouraged to take the helm and participate as much they desire, or just sit back and enjoy the ride. Bottled water and ice will be provided. Guests are welcome to bring additional food and drinks aboard to enjoy while cruising. A fully equipped galley is available for your use on all yachts 30’+.
